words.note_zh: 口语，只说一起变，不说谁导致谁。

words.grammar: a strong positive link between A and B

words.note_zh: 书面，形象地说两条线一起动。

patterns.frame: The dots go up from left to right: {subject} go together.
patterns.zh_frame: 点从左到右上升：{subject}同步变化。

patterns.frame: There is a strong positive link between {subject}, with a correlation of {r}.
patterns.zh_frame: {subject}之间有强正相关，相关系数为 {r}。
patterns.note_zh: between A and B 结构；correlation of + 数值。

traps.wrong_en: The chart shows that one variable causes higher the other.
traps.right_en: The chart shows that one variable and the other move together.
traps.why_zh: 散点只显示同时变化，不能证明因果。

registers.general: The dots climb from left to right: {subject} usually move together.
registers.ielts: There is a strong positive correlation between {subject}, at {r}.
registers.business: {subject} move together in this sample; that is a pattern to test, not a reason to act.

words.grammar: a loose link between A and B

words.note_zh: 比 will 委婉，不表绝对。

words.grammar: a moderate positive correlation between A and B
words.note_zh: 书面程度词，介于 slight 与 strong。
书面弱化，避免把中等相关说成强相关。

patterns.frame: People with more {x} usually get a bit more {y}, but not always.
patterns.zh_frame: {x}更多的人通常{y}多一点，但不总是。
patterns.note_zh: usually + but not always 是安全口径。

patterns.frame: There is a moderate positive link between {subject}, at about {r}.

traps.why_zh: 程度词固定用 moderate，不用 medium。

registers.general: People with more {x} usually get a bit more {y}, though the pattern is loose.
registers.ielts: The data suggests a moderate positive relationship between {subject}, at around {r}.
registers.business: {subject} are moderately linked, so other factors clearly matter.

words.grammar: a trade-off between A and B
collocations: a trade-off between speed and quality

words.grammar: an inverse relationship between A and B

words.note_zh: 书面；related to，但 correlate with，介词别混。

patterns.note_zh: the + 比较级, the + 比较级。

patterns.frame: {subject} show a strong inverse relationship, with a correlation of {r}.
patterns.note_zh: inverse relationship 比 negative 更清楚方向。

traps.wrong_en: The higher the price, the less the sales.
traps.right_en: The higher the price, the lower the sales.
traps.why_zh: 价格高低用 high/low；sales 用 low，不用 less。

registers.general: The dots slide down from left to right: more {x} usually means lower {y}.
registers.ielts: There is a strong negative correlation between {subject}, at {r}.
registers.business: {subject} trade off against each other; longer waits come with lower scores.

words.grammar: be less likely to + 动词
a negative link between A and B

words.note_zh: 说关系变弱，不说数值下降。

patterns.frame: More {x} tends to mean a little less {y}, but the pattern is weak.
patterns.zh_frame: {x}更多往往意味着{y}略少，但规律不强。
patterns.note_zh: tend to + 动词；a little 说幅度。

patterns.frame: The trend is mildly negative: more {x} comes with a small drop in {y}.
patterns.zh_frame: 趋势轻微负向：{x}增加，{y}小幅下降。

traps.wrong_en: The correlation is negative, so the data is bad.
traps.right_en: The correlation is negative: one value falls as the other rises.
traps.why_zh: negative 指方向，不是质量差。

registers.general: More {x} tends to mean a little less {y}, but the pattern is not strong.
registers.ielts: There is a mild negative correlation between {subject}, at about {r}.
registers.business: {subject} show a slight negative link; not enough to change the plan yet.

words.grammar: the dots are all over the place

words.note_zh: no real 比 no 留有余地。

words.grammar: a weak correlation between A and B

patterns.frame: There is no real pattern here: {subject} are all over the place.
patterns.zh_frame: 这里没有明显规律：{subject}杂乱分布。
patterns.note_zh: no real 是安全的弱化。

patterns.frame: The scatter shows no clear association between {subject}; the correlation is only {r}.
patterns.zh_frame: 散点显示{subject}没有明确关联，相关系数只有 {r}。

traps.wrong_en: The chart proves there is no relationship.
traps.right_en: The chart shows no clear relationship in this sample.
traps.why_zh: 样本无相关不等于完全无关，别用 prove。

registers.general: {subject} are all over the place; no pattern jumps out.
registers.ielts: The scatter plot shows no clear relationship between {subject}, with a correlation of only {r}.
registers.business: {subject} look uncorrelated in this sample, so we stopped treating one as a proxy for the other.

words.grammar: a dense cluster of + 名词

patterns.frame: Most points sit together in one part of the chart.
patterns.zh_frame: 大多数点挤在图中的一个区域。

patterns.frame: A dense cluster of {subject} falls in the middle of the plot, with only a few points outside.
patterns.zh_frame: {subject}的密集聚集区在图中间，少数点在外。
patterns.note_zh: with only a few 对比结构。

traps.wrong_en: There is a cluster of point.
traps.right_en: There is a cluster of points.

registers.general: Most points bunch up in the middle; only a few sit outside.
registers.ielts: Most observations cluster in the middle of the plot, with few points at the edges.
registers.business: Most users cluster in one band, so that is where the redesign matters.

collocations: one point is the odd one out

patterns.frame: One point sits far from the rest — an outlier.
patterns.zh_frame: 有一个点离其他点很远，是离群点。

patterns.frame: A single observation deviates sharply from the main cluster, so we check it before trusting the trend.
patterns.zh_frame: 单个观测明显偏离主群，先核查再判断趋势。

traps.wrong_en: One outlier shows the trend is wrong.
traps.right_en: One outlier pulls the trend, so we check whether it is a data error.
traps.why_zh: 离群点影响拟合，先查来源，不要直接下结论。

registers.general: One point sits way off on its own — that is an outlier.
registers.ielts: One observation lies well outside the main cluster and should be verified before any conclusion.
registers.business: A single account skews the average, so we exclude it from the trend line.

comparisons.meaning_zh: correlate 指两件事一起变动；cause 指一件事导致另一件。
comparisons.grammar_zh: correlate with + 名词；cause + 名词 或 cause sb/sth to do。
comparisons.collocations_zh: correlate strongly with / cause a rise
comparisons.usage_zh: 没有实验证据就用 correlate / be associated with，别用 cause。

examples.en: Study time correlates with scores, but this chart alone cannot show that it causes them.
examples.zh: 学习时长和分数相关，但仅凭这张图不能说明是它导致分数提高。

comparisons.meaning_zh: strong 表示关系紧密、点贴近一条线；slight 只表示轻微。
comparisons.grammar_zh: 两者都直接修饰 correlation / link / relationship。
comparisons.collocations_zh: a strong positive correlation / a slight upward trend
comparisons.usage_zh: 程度阶梯：slight < moderate < strong；别用 big 修饰 correlation。

examples.en: There is a strong link between commute time and stress, but only a slight link between tea and sleep.
examples.zh: 通勤时间和压力关系很强，茶和睡眠只有轻微关联。

comparisons.meaning_zh: associated with 只说同时出现；due to 明确归因。
comparisons.grammar_zh: be associated with + 名词；be due to + 名词（不接从句）。
comparisons.collocations_zh: be strongly associated with / be due to a lack of sleep
comparisons.usage_zh: 没有因果证据时一律用 associated with；due to 只用于已知原因。

examples.en: Late-night phone use is associated with poorer sleep, but the chart cannot show what is due to what.
examples.zh: 深夜用手机与睡眠变差有关，但图里看不出谁导致谁。

comparisons.meaning_zh: correlation 是可量化的统计相关；relationship 泛指关系，也可非线性。
comparisons.grammar_zh: a correlation between A and B；a relationship between A and B
comparisons.collocations_zh: a correlation coefficient / a close relationship
comparisons.usage_zh: correlation 常配数字和方向；relationship 更宽泛。

examples.en: The correlation is 0.72, which is fairly strong.

comparisons.meaning_zh: concentrate 强调集中到一处；cluster 指一群点挨在一起。
comparisons.collocations_zh: be concentrated at noon / cluster around the center
comparisons.usage_zh: 热力图说 activity is concentrated at noon；散点说 points cluster in the corner。

examples.en: Most points cluster in the middle, and activity is concentrated in two hours.
examples.zh: 大多数点聚集在中间，活动集中在两小时内。
